en.name: Hoisin sauce
en.summary: Hoisin is a thick, sweet-salty sauce built on fermented soybean, sugar, vinegar and spice, which is a combination that keeps well. Unopened it runs about 18–24 months in the cupboard from purchase. Once opened, refrigerate it and use it within about 3–6 months.
en.pantry: An unopened jar or bottle keeps about 18–24 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. Fermented soybean, salt, sugar and vinegar all work in its favour, so no refrigeration is needed while the seal is intact. Keep it upright, and do not store a jar whose lid has lost its vacuum or that is leaking sticky sauce down the side.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within about 3–6 months. Use a clean spoon each time, and never dip a brush that has touched raw meat back into the jar — that is the most common way a stable sauce is ruined. Wipe the rim before closing so dried sauce does not crust into the thread. The sauce thickens considerably in the cold; let it stand or stir it before brushing or glazing.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for hoisin sauce and no real need for one: sugar, salt and vinegar already keep it for months in the fridge, which is longer than most households take to work through a jar. Freezing would also separate it and coarsen the glossy texture that makes it useful as a glaze. Buy the jar size you will finish instead.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or around the rim
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell instead of a sweet, malty, savoury one
A domed lid, or fizzing when the jar is opened
The sauce dried to a dark crust or separated into a watery and a thick layer
tips: Decant sauce you are using as a glaze into a small bowl; never brush from the jar.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Wipe the rim before closing so the lid does not glue itself shut.
Buy a small bottle if you use hoisin only for the occasional duck pancake.

faq.q: Does hoisin sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Refrigerate at 4 °C or below and use within about 3–6 months.

faq.q: How long does unopened hoisin sauce last?
faq.a: About 18–24 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, provided the seal is intact.
There is no timeline and no need. It keeps for months refrigerated, and freezing separates it.

faq.q: Can you reuse hoisin that has touched raw meat?
faq.a: No. Once a brush has been on raw meat, anything it goes back into is contaminated. Decant what you need into a separate bowl first.

zh.name: 海鮮醬
zh.summary: 海鮮醬是以發酵黃豆、糖、醋和香料做成的濃稠甜鹹醬，這個組合本來就很耐放。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐裝或瓶裝放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。發酵黃豆、鹽、糖和醋都在幫它，所以只要封口完好就不需要冷藏。請直立擺放；蓋子沒有真空感，或側面有黏稠醬汁滲出的就不要再存放。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。每次都用乾淨的湯匙，而且沾過生肉的刷子絕對不要再伸進罐子——那是穩定的醬料最常見的毀滅方式。蓋回去前先擦瓶口，避免醬垢卡進螺紋。低溫下醬會明顯變稠；刷醬或上釉前先回溫或攪拌一下。
zh.freezer: 海鮮醬沒有冷凍期限，實際上也不需要：糖、鹽和醋已經讓它在冰箱裡放好幾個月，比多數家庭用完一罐的時間還長。冷凍還會讓它分離、失去那層當作刷醬時很好用的光澤質地。與其冷凍，不如買你用得完的容量。
spoilage: 聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味，而不是甜香帶麥芽的鹹香
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
醬乾成深色硬殼，或分離成水層和稠層
tips: 要當刷醬時先舀到小碗；絕對不要直接從罐子裡刷。
蓋回去前擦瓶口，免得瓶蓋黏死。
只有偶爾做烤鴨捲餅的話，買小瓶就好。

faq.a: 要。放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。

faq.q: 未開封的海鮮醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要封口完好，陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它冷藏就能放好幾個月，冷凍反而會分離。

faq.q: 刷過生肉的海鮮醬還能用嗎？
faq.a: 不行。刷子碰過生肉之後，它再回到的任何容器都算被污染。請先把需要的量舀到另一個碗。
